## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Search ad (headline and description) for Pebblebrook Tea Co., UK. No date or audience was given.

**Checks**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Claims | Pass. Both claims match the policy allowlist. |
| Regulated claims | Pass. "Organic" is backed by the Soil Association certificate (renewed 2026), so it is not a broad green claim. The delivery offer states its condition (over £25) and has no false urgency. |
| House style | Pass. It is plain and unhurried, with no banned words and no AI tells. Score about 95/100. |
| Disclosure | Pass. This is a paid ad from the brand's own account, so the platform marks it and no extra label is needed. |

**Claims table**

| Claim | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Organic Loose Leaf Tea | On policy list (organic) and product fact (loose leaf) | Soil Association certificate, 2026 |
| Certified organic by the Soil Association | On policy list, exact wording | Certificate on file, renewed 2026 |
| Free UK delivery on orders over £25 | On policy list, exact wording | Shipping policy |

**Evidence log rows**
- 2026-11-17 | Search ad (organic and delivery) | Organic Loose Leaf Tea | Supported | Soil Association certificate, 2026
- 2026-11-17 | Search ad (organic and delivery) | Certified organic by the Soil Association | Supported | Policy section 2
- 2026-11-17 | Search ad (organic and delivery) | Free UK delivery on orders over £25 | Supported | Shipping policy

**Fixed:** Nothing needed changing.

**Needs a decision:** Nothing is unresolved. One small suggestion: confirm the ad's landing page also mentions the organic certification and the £25 delivery threshold, because an ad can't claim more than the page it links to.
